newsitem.title: UK: UK Liberals have 2.5 million stg election fund.
newsitem.headline: UK Liberals have 2.5 million stg election fund.

text.p: Britain's minority Liberal Democrats will go into the general election expected next year with a fighting fund of some 2-1/2 million stg, a senior party official told a news conference on Tuesday.
Lord Richard Holme, who chairs the committee coordinating the party's general election strategy, said the figure was between five and 10 percent higher than at the 1992 election.
But it is only a fraction of the more than 10 million pounds which both the ruling Conservatives and the opposition Labour Party are expected to spend.
